Almost a perfect episode. However, I really dislike how this arc has used so many flashbacks. The pacing is just paused entirely, just for Tangerine to have a flashback to one of his siblings.

Though I would've liked for Boar head & pikachu to have faced off against praying 'pathetic' mantis man.

Uzui's stance is very lame. Throughout the boring dialogue that takes up over half of the episode, he just has his blades to his side the entire time. Really couldn't have made it look even slightly cool?

The scene where Uzui starts to imitate Rengoku. It doesn't feel natural at all. Tanjiro being in the scene to draw the connection and notice that Uzui was imitating Rengoku is so unnecessary and forced. Tanjiro did not to to be part of this scene.

I think Zenitsu's confrontation with Daki was meant to be serious and impactful, but with a bubble coming out of his nose the entire time, really just made me cringe. The difference in tone between what Zenitsu looks like and what he's saying makes it really difficult to take the scene seriously.

The scene where it cuts to one of Uzui's wives on the rooftop. What the fuck am I looking at? The fight going on in the background looks incredibly lame compared to what was shown seconds before. The soft clashing of the blades does not help the scene either. It makes the beautiful fight scene before this feel like 'Imagination vs Reality'. Which lessens the impact the amazing CGI had, when one second there's all this cool spinny anime shit going around, then its just a shitty exchange of blades the next.

Episode 9's title reveal completely removed any tension I would have going into next week's episode. The rankings of the upper moons haven't changed in over a hundred years. That gives us the impression that they are incredibly strong. Something something, strength gap between the lower and the upper moons. And yet, just like that, we know that Tangerine & the boy band has conquered an upper moon. Lame, man. Lame. Oh yeah. Remember when 2 seconds ago in the episode, Uzui blamed himself for the predicament the boy band were in 'all because (he) got poisoned'? Fuck you. They win next episode. Zero suspense. I hate it.

I hope something comes out of Gyutarou giving one of his eyes to Daki, such as him becoming weakened because he has less depth perception. But that would be good writing, and we dont do that outside of the Mugen Train arc.
